Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 15

“The person whom these do not disturb, who is steady and alike in pain and pleasure — that one is fit for immortality, best of men.”

Immortality here is described as a fitness, something a person becomes suited for by temperament. Evenness is not indifference but a stability that suffering and delight cannot knock over.
